instruction.name: xvreplve.w
instruction.description: Repeat an indexed element in each 128-bit lane.

latencies.notes: Register dependency latency. Raw measurement was 1.07; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplve.w $xr0, $xr8, $r4; xvreplve.w $xr1, $xr9, $r5; xvreplve.w $xr2, $xr10, $r6; xvreplve.w $xr3, $xr11, $r7; xvreplve.w $xr4, $xr12, $r8; xvreplve.w $xr5, $xr13, $r9; xvreplve.w $xr6, $xr14, $r10; xvreplve.w $xr7, $xr15, $r11
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, 0; li.d $r7, 0; li.d $r8, 0; li.d $r9, 0; li.d $r10, 0; li.d $r11, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, 0; li.d $r7, 0; li.d $r8, 0; li.d $r9, 0; li.d $r10, 0; li.d $r11, 0' --asm 'xvreplve.w $xr0, $xr8, $r4; xvreplve.w $xr1, $xr9, $r5; xvreplve.w $xr2, $xr10, $r6; xvreplve.w $xr3, $xr11, $r7; xvreplve.w $xr4, $xr12, $r8; xvreplve.w $xr5, $xr13, $r9; xvreplve.w $xr6, $xr14, $r10; xvreplve.w $xr7, $xr15, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.62 cycles. Measured CPI 1.0775; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 1. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LASX vector instruction measured on LA664. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
